title: The liner smells terrible!
text: The liner smells terrible!. This is exactly what I needed for my bedroom. However the black liner absolutely stinks. It smells of cheap processed fabric/plastic. I soaked it in fabreeze and I'm letting it air out.

product_metadata.title: Household Essentials 6540-1 Collapsible Bamboo X-Frame Laundry Hamper | Bamboo Frame with Black Canvas Bag, Brown
features: Bamboo x-frame clothes hamper with removable liner for bedrooms, laundry rooms, and closets
Features 1 large removable polycotton laundry bag - bag is washable in cold water with like colors, air-dry
Sturdy, bamboo frame collapses for easy storage when not it use
description: Household Essentials Bamboo collection is a gorgeous upscale design for a laundry hamper. This sustainable and renewable bamboo hamper is designed with a modern and elegant look to coordinate with any décor. The bamboo hamper has a heavy canvas bag that holds two loads of laundry. The bag is removable and machine washable. Hamper quickly folds for space saving storage when not in use. The bag is black in color. Setup dimensions are: 32.3-Inch by 15-3/4-Inch high by 14.1-Inch deep. Item #6540.
